title: Signal: go.sum records a non-standard hash prefix
scope: A go.sum file that declares a checksum file in which no line carries the expected `h1:` hash.
limitations: It matches a checksum file in which no line carries the expected `h1:` hash in the parsed go.sum; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A go.sum that mentions a checksum file in which no line carries the expected `h1:` hash in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
